title: kozola japonica
intro: Kozola japonica, commonly known as Japanese angelica tree or Kinsen, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Kozola japonica are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce fever, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
